subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should shared user-path resolution expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` placeholders for workspace/config/state paths, and should unknown placeholders stay literal or fail closed?
rationale: The failure is source-proven, but the natural fix changes a shared config/path interpretation rule that affects more than skill installation.

options.title: Expand known env path placeholders
options.body: Support `$VAR` and `${VAR}` expansion in the shared path resolver, keep unknown placeholders explicit, and add resolver plus skill-install tests.

options.title: Normalize before runtime only
options.body: Keep path helpers literal and fix only the config/dotenv layer that authors the workspace path before runtime callers receive it.

options.title: Defer to dotenv policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader dotenv interpolation policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38259 settles the env-expansion contract.

recommendation.title: Expand known env path placeholders
recommendation.body: Support `$VAR` and `${VAR}` expansion in the shared path resolver, keep unknown placeholders explicit, and add resolver plus skill-install tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is recent work on the shared path helper and skills CLI surfaces affected by the decision.
